doc:
### PROPOSAL-07 — Japanese Ukiyo-e / Woodblock Print - **slug**: `ukiyo-e` - **Vibe**: The great wave of data — indigo, washi paper, and vermilion seals composed like a woodblock print. - **Best for**: Product show pages and the campaign calendar — calm, disciplined surfaces with artful accents. Adjectives: serene, disciplined, artful. - **Palette** (light theme, `is_dark: false`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#efe6cf` | Washi-paper canvas | | `--bg-surface` | `#f7f1e0` | Lighter washi panel fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#fffaf0` | Raised paper, modals | | `--border-subtle` | `#ddd0b0` | Fine ink hairlines | | `--border-default` | `#b7a37c` | Standard woodblock borders | | `--border-focus` | `#d9423a` | Vermilion focus outline | | `--text-primary` | `#20263f` | Indigo-ink headings | | `--text-secondary` | `#4c4f63` | Body text | | `--text-muted` | `#6f6c5e` | Captions, dates, fine print | | `--color-action` | `#d9423a` | Vermilion primary action | | `--color-action-hover` | `#bd342e` | Action hover (deeper vermilion) | | `--color-earnings` | `#2e6b4f` | Ukiyo-e green earnings | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#245640` | Earnings hover (deeper green) | | `--color-automation` | `#2f5d9e` | Indigo-blue automation accents | | `--color-alert` | `#c98a1b` | Gold/ochre warnings | | `--color-danger` | `#a22f2f` | Dark vermilion destructive states | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(217, 66, 58, 0.14)` | Vermilion tint behind action icons | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(46, 107, 79, 0.14)` | Green tint behind earnings icons | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(47, 93, 158, 0.14)` | Indigo tint behind automation icons | - **Typography**: Display: `"Shippori Mincho B1", "Noto Serif JP", Georgia, serif` — a modulated, bookish serif for headings. Sans: `"Zen Kaku Gothic New", "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif` for body. Mono: `"IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` for timestamps and IDs. Minimal tracking; numerals `tabular-nums`. - **Radii & Borders**: Small and crisp — 2px radius on cards and buttons. Borders are 1px thin ink lines. Cards use the **double-line woodblock frame**: a 1px outer border plus a second 1px inner border inset 3px. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Rectangular, thin 1px border. Primary = vermilion fill with white text (AA-large, bold). Secondary = outlined in ink with indigo text. Tertiary = text with a small vermilion square before it. Focus = 2px vermilion outline with a 2px gap. - **Cards**: Washi-paper fill with the double-line frame; an optional faint woodgrain/watermark (SVG noise at 3% opacity) in one corner. No shadows — print is flat. - **Badges/Status**: Seal-stamp badges — small squares with rounded corners (hanko style) in vermilion, indigo, or green; white text. Publishing = indigo seal with a soft breathe. - **Tables**: Thin 1px grid lines; header row has a subtle indigo wash; row hover = 1px vermilion left tick. Numbers feel like printed ledger figures. - **Forms/Inputs**: Bordered boxes with 1px ink lines; focus = vermilion bottom rule. Labels in small, slightly tracked sans. - **Loading**: A brush-stroke bar that sweeps left to right, or a small "wave" motif that gently undulates. - **Signature detail**: The vermilion hanko seal used as the logo mark and status stamp, plus double-line frames and washi texture — a print, not a screen. - **Motion & Animation**: Slow and ceremonial: entries use a "paper-turn" feel (400ms, slight rotateX, fade), and Turbo Stream updates wipe in with a vertical "iris" reveal. Nothing bounces. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
MON · 12 3 posts queued 稿
```
